gaps.sentence: A decision ___ once all the evidence has been reviewed.
gaps.explanation: The decision cannot make itself: future passive will be + made.

gaps.sentence: Did you have the brakes ___ (check) before the long drive?
gaps.hint: question form of have something done
gaps.explanation: Causative question: Did you have + the brakes + checked? A mechanic did the checking.

gaps.sentence: English ___ (speak) as a first language in more than fifty countries.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: is + spoken. Facts about the language, not about a speaker.

gaps.sentence: Too much time ___ (waste) on pointless meetings these days.
gaps.explanation: 'These days' signals a present general situation: is + wasted (singular 'time').

gaps.sentence: The temple is thought ___ (build) more than two thousand years ago.
gaps.explanation: Perfect passive infinitive: to have been + built for an event earlier than the main verb.

gaps.sentence: She ___ (think) to be the finest violinist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive: is thought to be. The thinkers are general, not stated.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium ___ by the end of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'By the end of the decade' needs future perfect passive: will have been + completed. The stadium is completed by somebody.

gaps.sentence: The tickets ___ at the door from seven o'clock.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: can be + collected. The tickets are collected by the buyers.
